next.reason: 1985: "LABEL {RECORD IS|RECORDS ARE} {STANDARD|OMITTED} VALUE OF implementor-name-1 IS ... DATA {RECORD IS|RECORDS ARE}"; 2023: "FD file-name-1 [ IS EXTERNAL [ AS literal-1 ] ] [ IS GLOBAL ] [FORMAT ...] [ BLOCK CONTAINS ... ] [ record-clause ]". The 2023 FD formats keep EXTERNAL and GLOBAL but drop the LABEL RECORDS, VALUE OF and DATA RECORDS clauses. They add AS literal-1 and FORMAT, so the accepted programs differ.
